title: BP-CONTROL Master Protocol: blood-pressure targets in adults at increased cardiovascular risk

descriptionSummary: Master protocol governing a set of randomised components that compare intensive with standard blood-pressure control across cardiovascular, cognitive and kidney outcome domains in a shared randomised population.
